notes.title: Tech Update: 7.01.2021 | Save file issue has been fixed!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24296578/0549db87c46f87641ded3bd1b36c85b5b7acbd10.jpg

Hi there, Detectives!

Good news! We've just updated the game with a small but important fix! It's a fix for the issue that prevented the players from loading the game from a save slot. The update is live now.

In case of further problems after the patch, please let us know here. Thank you.

We wish you all the best in 2021, stay safe!

Cheers,
11 bit studios & Pixel Crow

notes.title: Children of Morta | RELEASE DATE!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/4da414f87fd53bf88bdc8abf55ab0aab72236428.jpg

Hi there, Community!

We have some pretty amazing news for you today!

Children of Morta will be arriving on PC this September 3, 2019. The Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4 versions of the game will launch on October 15, 2019. To celebrate the launch date announcement, you can check out the all-new trailer below.

Watch our brand-new "It Runs in the Family" trailer here:
https://youtu.be/_oapcHvc6UQ
About the game:
Corruption has spread, morphing the once peaceful Mount Morta into a violent and monster-infested nightmare. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for? Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG about a valiant family standing together while the world around them is devoured in darkness. Lead the Bergsons, with all their flaws and virtues, and experience what it means to be in a family of heroes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/cb35ca8aaa12e739afa0d4cb0778517d7c23c405.gif

Children of Morta copes with themes closer to our daily lives than one would expect. It is a story of the simple emotions we all know so well — and value more than sometimes we dare to admit — love and hope, longing and uncertainty, ultimately loss and the sacrifices we are willing to make to save the ones we care the most for.

We hope you're as excited about the release date as we are! We're working very hard to deliver the best family-themed rogue-lite out there - and we're really hoping you're going to love it!

Take care,
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

Version 1.0.628 - French, Chinese, Japanese + Bugfixing
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/fca770b03b7c5355d805e46d1529bde3cdd27627.png

Hi everyone!

We’re very happy to bring French, Chinese and Japanese translations.  Sorry we kept you waiting but Beat Cop is pretty massive when it comes to script length and delivering every translation is a unique challenge especially for a small indie team. 

Besides adding new languages we fixed the bellow issues:
Kelly being stuck in a dialogue
Messy font size and shape in some areas
Few missing translations in various languages
Wrong task descriptions for few quest
Porn quest blockers
Shaking NPCs
Missing car “blocking” the fire hydrant
Other minor stability and quality fixes
We really hope you will like those and thanks again for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.0.610 is now live!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/72d65b2bffbcafa7117f3fc9c01effddd813ca1d.png

Hi everyone!

Version 1.0.610 is now live!

Changelog:
Day 16. Fix for a situation when congratulations from the crowd were happening before the heist.
Day 21: New notes and comments better explaining story related tasks.
Day 21: Fixing the notes appearing in the recap after day 21.
Day 19: Notes about taxis now disappear after the quest is finished.
Global: Police Squad taking care of the caught robber now appears faster
Global: Game balance – day length tweaks. Some days are now a bit longer to lower the tempo.
Global: Dozens of minor text translation updates.
Global: Few new SFX added.
Global: Old notes are now deleted from the notepad after a new game is started.
Global: Beat Cat Mode can’t be turned on during cutscenes anymore
Global: Minor notepad user layout improvements
Global: A thief in a white shirt should now be properly described by the witnesses
Global: Plenty of other minor fixes.

Additional Notes:

For Mac Users:
Please note that Integrated graphics cards such as Intel HD Graphics or Iris Graphics are not recommended for resolutions higher than 1280 x 800 and may not allow playing in 30+ frames depending on their performance.

For Linux Users:
Please remember that Beat Cop on Linux requires latest drivers for your system as well as SDL2 libraries installed. Lack of those may cause problems launching the game.

As always, thank you for playing and for your amazing feedback!

notes.title: Update! New languages and fixes!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/1a6b5433960794ca0a2d03bc32fef44ca2095230.png

Hey there, everyone!

It's update time! We know that you've been waiting for new languages to be available in game - and we are sorry that we couldn't provide them on the release they. But they're finally here alongside some bug fixes!

List of changes:
Language support - enjoy Beat Cop in three more languages: Spanish, Russian and Brazilian Portuguese!
Day 21 bug - we resolved the potential conflict that appeared during few of game's endings on Day 21; now you should be able to finish Beat Cop with no issues (again)
some minor stability and text-related tweaks

Also, remember to to update your game to the newest version!

Yes, we plan to add more languages in the near future and yes, we're still collecting feedback from you. If something is wrong with your game - just describe it in "Tech Stuff" section on Steam Discussions. 

Thank you for playing Beat Cop! Have a good one!​

notes.title: New update 1.0.585 available now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

we've just posted a fresh update. We're still working hard on improving the game based on your feedback. This time we focused on:

 Fixing an issue with the "time passed" screen. Now it appears and ... disappears, so it should be just fine :]
 Fixing a problem making it hard to talk to the priest NPC in day 20.
 German font and layout improvements.
 Sound setting should now be saved properly.
 Starting disclaimer may now be skipped.
 Minor VSync fixes.
 Plenty of minor tweaks here and there.

Thank for playing and thanks for sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Beat Cop has a release date! Also, cats.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24296578/2b04698b534a9264bc8888bd36f9d3ca68713522.jpg

Hi there, everyone!

We are very happy to announce that Beat Cop has a release date! Game will be available on 30th of March 2017 - so get your handcuffs and donuts ready!

Also, to celebrate that, we have something really cool for you... something that you always wanted to see - even though you didn't even know about that. It was hidden deep inside your heart. And finally - it is here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=awh6_Ho_26A
And just so you know: this is not a joke! We are going to have this mode available for Beat Cop when the game is released. In the meantime, we hope you enjoyed our little video.

Cheers!
